note:
Duration of residence is calculated based on number of days, and a new year does not occur until 364 days become 365 days. This means that if a person has been recorded in the Swedish population register for 729 days (1 year and 364 days), that person ends up in the group Duration of residence 0–1 years. If the person has been recorded in the population register for 730 days, the person ends up in the group Duration of residence 2–3 years. The breakdown of other groups works in a similar way, which means that a person must have a duration of residence of at least 3,650 days to end up in the group Duration of residence 10– years. Ahead of the year 2000, considerable changes were made to the Register of Education to improve quality, with a new nomenclature and a number of new sources, which led to a break in the time series. For this reason, comparisons with prior years must be made with great caution. For more information see:  [Quality improvement in the Register of Education, 2000 (in Swedish))(https://www.scb.se/hitta-statistik/statistik-efter-amne/utbildning-samt-forskning-inom-hogskolan/befolkningens-utbildning-och-studiedeltagande/befolkningens-utbildning/produktrelaterat/Fordjupad-information/kvalitetshojningen-i-utbildningsregistret-ar-2000/).. 
  
Data on employment is taken from [Population by Labour market status](https://www.scb.se/am0210-en)

000007JJ:
The numerator consists of persons who sometime during the year have been registered as unemployed according to the register of the Swedish Public Employment Service. A person is defined as being registered as unemployed if during the year they have been registered as openly unemployed and/or job-seeking in programmes with activity support. The denominator consists of the population.  
Source: [STATIV database](https://www.scb.se/STATIV)
000007JK:
The numerator consists of persons who, sometime during the year, have been registered as openly unemployed in the job-seeking category for open unemployment. As of the 2018 update of new data from 1997 and onwards, the content of Proportion of persons openly unemployed was also adjusted. Previously, it only included persons who, in the past job-seeking period, were registered as openly unemployed. Before the change, a person could only belong to one job-seeking category in the year concerned. The denominator consists of the population. 
  
Source: [STATIV](https://www.scb.se/STATIV)
000007JL:
The numerator consists of persons who, sometime during the year, have been registered as job-seeking in programmes with activity support. The indicator is created by means of grouping the same job-seeking categories used by the Swedish Public Employment Service in its statistics on job-seekers in programmes each year. As of the 2018 update of new data from 1997 and onwards, the content of Proportion of job-seekers in programmes with activity support was also adjusted. Previously, it only included persons who, in the past job-seeking period, were registered as job-seekers in programmes with activity support. Before the change, a person could only belong to one job-seeking category in the year concerned. The denominator consists of the population. 
  
Source: [STATIV](https://www.scb.se/STATIV)
000007JM:
The numerator consists of persons under the age of 25 who are registered as openly unemployed with the Swedish Public Employment Service sometime during the year, for a consecutive period of at least 100 days, and for 25+ years at least six months. The denominator consists of the population. 
  
Source: [STATIV](https://www.scb.se/STATIV)
000007JO:
The numerator consists of persons who are business operators in both year t and year  t-1. The denominator consists of the number business operators in year t-1 in each region. The calculation is only made for persons who are recorded in the population register both years. 
  
Source: [Population by Labour market status](https://www.scb.se/am0210-en)
000007JF:
The numerator consists of persons employed in the occupational area managers according to SSYK. The denominator consists of persons who are employed and active and who have a classified occupation.  
  
As of 2014, occupational data is reported according to the revised Swedish Standard Classification of Occupations (SSYK 2012). SSYK 2012 replaces the previous version, SSYK96. This means that comparisons between 2014 and previous years should not be made. For employees in the 16–64 age range, in 2014 most occupation data, 74 percent, refers to circumstances in the reference year or the following year. 19 percent of the data is imputed using a model that uses the occupation code (according to SSYK 96) that the individual already had in the register. The previous code used may be a maximum of five years old. 
 Source: [The Swedish Occupational Register with statistics](https://www.scb.se/am0208-en)  
Description of SSYK: [The Swedish Standard Classification of Occupations 2012 SSYK](https://www.scb.se/ssyk/)  
Description of gainfully employed: Source: [Population by Labour market status](https://www.scb.se/am0210-en)
000007JG:
The numerator consists of persons who have post-secondary education and who work in occupational area 2 (occupations requiring advanced level of higher education) and 3 (occupations requiring higher education or equivalent) according to SSYK. The denominator consists of persons who are employed and who have post-secondary education.  
  As of 2014, occupational data is reported according to the revised Swedish Standard Classification of Occupations (SSYK 2012). SSYK 2012 replaces the previous version, SSYK96. This means that comparisons between 2014 and previous years should not be made. For employees in the 16–64 age range, in 2014 most occupation data, 74 percent, refers to circumstances in the reference year or the following year. 19 percent of the data is imputed using a model that uses the occupation code (according to SSYK 96) that the individual already had in the register. The previous code used may be a maximum of five years old. 
  
Source: [The Swedish Occupational Register with statistics](https://www.scb.se/am0208-en)  
Description of SSYK: [The Swedish Standard Classification of Occupations 2012 SSYK](https://www.scb.se/ssyk/)  
Description of education: [Educational attainment of the population](http://www.scb.se/uf0506-en)  
Description of gainfully employed: Source: [Population by Labour market status](https://www.scb.se/am0210-en)
000007JH:
The numerator consist of persons who have post-secondary education and who have employment within qualification levels 3 and 4 according to SSYK2012. The occupational areas that are included in qualification levels 3 and 4 are managerial occupations, occupations requiring an advanced level of higher education or equivalent, and officers in the armed forces occupational area.    The denominator consists of persons who are employed and who have post-secondary education. To be included in the denominator, a person must have an occupation classified according to SSYK2012.  
Source: [The Swedish Occupational Register with statistics](https://www.scb.se/am0208-en).  
Description of SSYK: [The Swedish Standard Classification of Occupations 2012 SSYK](https://www.scb.se/ssyk/).  
Description of education: [Educational attainment of the population](http://www.scb.se/uf0506-en).  
Description of gainfully employed: Source: [Population by Labour market status](https://www.scb.se/am0210-en).
